info.title: Pablo Local Control API
info.description: HTTP JSON control, live inspection, and live action calls over Pablo's current-user Unix-domain socket. Caller identity comes from socket peer credentials and process ancestry, never request fields. Agents should inspect a fresh accessibility frame before acting, prefer exact node IDs, and inspect again afterward to verify the intended state change. Foreground actions are locked by default.

servers.description: Unix-domain socket transport; the host is not contacted.

post.summary: Execute one caller-bound mutation with a recoverable receipt
post.description: Requires a verified calling application and normal human approval for the nested command. Payload is the ordinary method body. Repeated identical requests return the retained receipt; a different caller or payload cannot reuse the key. Only a payload digest is retained, never the typed input. Requests expire after 300 seconds and serviceID changes on app restart. Never replay expired or unknown operations.

post.summary: Read this verified caller's retained operation, including while approval is pending
Request cancellation of this caller's operation without undoing dispatched effects
Read build, methods, privacy readiness, and this caller's approval state without prompting
post.description: Available before daily approval. Does not expose workspace paths, target inventory, other callers, or captured content. Privacy checks never request a grant. Readiness is advisory and is revalidated at action time. Safari grants require safari.tabs.

post.summary: List current application PIDs and connected display IDs after daily approval
post.description: Application windows and their live session IDs are discovered with inspect.live using a returned PID. Safari grants are discovered with safari.tabs. Discovery never starts observation or recording. Targets can disappear after discovery.

Consent-gated live state. kind observe returns a fresh compact accessibility observation, optionally paired with a window screenshot. It never starts input monitoring or writes a recording. Other kinds retain their existing frame and event-history behavior.

Control a live application. Pablo does not activate the target by default. Accessibility `perform` actions and single left clicks on nodes exposing AXPress, selectText, and setValue can run in the background. Actions that require target activation fail unless unlockForegroundActions is true. That option is NOT RECOMMENDED and agents must not set it without the user's explicit acceptance of the focus change. Optional observation options collect fresh state after dispatch in the same call. A failed observation preserves the dispatch result and returns observationFailure; do not automatically repeat the action. Paste temporarily uses the clipboard and reports whether it was restored or a newer clipboard value was preserved.

Inspect or manipulate the active Safari tab without activating Safari. The user must enable Pablo Safari and click its toolbar button on the tab first. The activeTab grant ends when the tab navigates. Pablo requests no persistent website access; results are derived from the page DOM, not WebKit's private native accessibility tree.

List the active tab in each Safari window for which the user has clicked the Pablo Safari toolbar button since the most recent navigation. The operation neither activates Safari nor requests persistent website access.

post.summary: Select an unresolved package or explicitly save interrupted evidence
post.description: Requires recordingID from rrweb.recordings. Other packages and spools remain intact. A healthy current recording must be stopped first. After selection, use rrweb.status or rrweb.stop to retrieve Safari's acknowledgment. Missing acknowledgments remain recovery-needed; selection never implies completion. With recoveryAction finishInterrupted, the matching selected package must already need recovery. Close its original Safari tab first: this action cannot stop an unreachable recorder. It saves received events as interrupted, retains the spool for late delivery, and clears the active recovery state. It never reports complete evidence. Use an operation envelope for safe retries.

Start masked rrweb event capture in one tab returned by safari.tabs. Pablo generates the recording identifier and writes a .pablo package with an rrweb event source; the caller supplies only the current tab ID.
Stop capture, persist all received events, and finalize the package.
Return a saved recording manifest and optionally a bounded prefix of its rrweb events. Supply exactly one recording selector.

Open a schema-v3 .pablo package in the normal Pablo player. Native and rrweb event sources use the same review window and transport controls. The output is a ReviewState with the review ID and current renderer readiness. Loading video may still be in progress when the window opens.
Return coherent states of open review windows in most-recent activation order. Reading does not activate a window. Each output item has the ReviewState shape.
Read one ReviewState from the same model used by the human review UI. A closed or unknown review ID fails. No live application is targeted.

Apply a semantic command to one open review and return ReviewOperation in output. The exact request and operation ID can be retried for five minutes after issuedAt; deduplication is bound to the verified caller and complete request payload. The service ID changes after restart. Expired requests fail before dispatch. Renderer commands complete only after observed playback settles. Human context changes interrupt a pending command. Unsaved human drafts block context changes.

Read source-qualified recorded evidence without changing selection or playback. Point coordinates are normalized inside the current native viewport. Timeline cursors are offsets in the same bounded range and revision; restart a query after context changes. Image export requires a paused, settled renderer and returns bounded PNG bytes with source, time, crop and observation provenance. Native images use the video composition; web images contain the rendered recorded viewport. No evidence file is modified. Native AX point queries are unsupported for web sources.

Read a caller-bound ReviewOperation while it is running or after completion. Receipts expire five minutes after issuedAt. Unavailable or expired does not prove that a command was not executed; inspect current state before deciding on any new operation. Unverified caller receipts are restricted to the same process.

Request cancellation of a caller-bound operation without waiting behind its mutation. Returns cancellationRequested until the pending command stops. Already completed effects are not undone; terminal receipts are returned unchanged. Receipts expire five minutes after issuedAt. Unavailable or expired does not prove that a command was not executed; inspect current state before deciding on any new operation. Unverified caller receipts are restricted to the same process.

Return a bounded ChangePage of review, renderer, and operation changes. Retains 256 events and admits at most four concurrent watchers. Ordinary playback ticks are omitted; changes within one model turn are coalesced. On resyncRequired, reread current state before issuing context-dependent commands.

BadRequest.description: Unsupported method URL, malformed HTTP, or malformed JSON

payload.description: The chosen method's normal request schema; use an empty object for methods without a body. Only mutation kinds are supported for safari.dom.

resultOmitted.description: A response larger than 256 KiB is omitted from bounded receipt storage. The original executing connection receives the complete response with resultOmitted false; subsequent status reads or duplicate execute calls return resultOmitted true. Inspect state when a retained result was omitted.

OperationReceipt.description: Up to 64 receipts are retained. Active operations remain observable after their nominal expiry until they settle. Completed means the method completed; live action effects remain unverified. Status/cancel disclose only this verified caller's prior result and do not bypass approval for new commands.

ControlFailure.description: notDispatched guarantees the requested operation did not start. outcomeUnknown requires state inspection; never automatically retry a mutation. Permission readiness cannot grant access. The error string provides the human-readable detail.

reference.description: Source-qualified A11Y frame, timeline item ID, or NOTE reference as appropriate for kind.

windowID.description: Recorded window ID; omit for the full recording canvas.

timestampNs.description: Explicit note anchor on the session timeline; never inferred from a moving playhead.

sourceID.description: SHA-256 of the loaded manifest; copied evidence retains this identity.

generation.description: New for every load, including replacement at the same path.

serviceID.description: App-process receipt namespace; changes on restart.

revision.description: Logical context revision; ordinary playback clock ticks do not advance it.

renderedSeconds.description: Last renderer-observed time; absent until a renderer reports it.

videoAvailability.description: Native track coverage at this time; separate from renderer readiness or decoding errors.

ApplicationTarget.description: Supply exactly one application selector. Action window/frame preconditions require sessionID.

sessionID.description: Expected live inspection session; a mismatch or eviction rejects the request before capture or dispatch.

windowID.description: Live AX window ID from inspect/frames. Actions fail if it closes or loses focus; there is no fallback.

frameReference.description: Optional action precondition requiring this to remain the latest live frame.

recordingPath.description: Absolute path to a schema-v3 .pablo package.

coordinateFrame.description: Desktop bounds in logical points for the normalized samples. If omitted, Pablo binds the trace to the recording canvas when the annotation is added. Stored traces retain this frame across display changes.

LiveInspectionRequest.description: Live frames have LIVE-sessionUUID/A11Y-ordinal references. Unqualified recording references are not live references. frames returns reference/session/frame envelopes; frame returns one envelope. events returns sessionID, observing, capturesText, indexed events, nextCursor, oldestSequence, newestSequence, and resyncRequired. Supply the returned sessionID with every subsequent cursor. observationStop stops input and forgets the entire inspection session, expiring all its frames and node IDs. inspect includes windows and actionCapabilities; frame nodes include observed actions and settableAttributes (nil means unavailable, empty means none). A node's AXPress permits a background click; other foreground input requires an explicit unlock. observe also accepts target.windowID and target.frameReference; other inspection kinds reject them. Observation options apply only to kind observe.

after.description: Last consumed event sequence; requires target.sessionID. Omit for the latest page.

includeText.description: Observation text capture setting; defaults to true at start and preserves the active setting thereafter.

baselineReference.description: This caller's last live frame reference. Retained baselines are compared directly, regardless of intervening reads by other callers.

LiveObservationOptions.description: Missing baseline or full true returns full state. An unavailable baseline returns full state with resyncRequired true. quietMilliseconds must not exceed timeoutMilliseconds. Zero quiet time takes one sample. Polling stops at the timeout and reports timedOut; native API calls may delay sample completion. Screenshot collection is separate from this polling budget and requires Screen Recording permission. The selected window is target.windowID, or the largest available accessible window. No target activation is required for inspection.

settableAttributes.description: Observed writable attributes for supported non-secure text controls. Revalidated at action time.

selectedTextRange.description: Observed UTF-16 selection or zero-length cursor range for a non-secure text control. Omitted when unavailable.

LiveTreeObservation.description: Full mode supplies nodes and no changes. Delta mode supplies only additions, complete node replacements, and removals against baselineReference. The text view uses +, ~, and -; application strings are quoted and shortened independently of structured values. textTruncated describes only this display view. truncated describes the accessibility walker. A delta with no changes is explicit.

LiveObservationOutput.description: An observation is evidence of sampled state, not proof of an action's intended effect. A screenshot is bound to this observation ID, frame reference, and window. Its frame uses desktop points with a top-left origin; pixel coordinates scale independently by width/frame.width and height/frame.height. The app verifies process, window geometry, and accessibility state around image capture. AX and image capture are not atomic; animation without AX changes may remain visible. PNG data is capped at 6 MiB and images at 2048 pixels per side.

LiveActionRequest.description: A validated live action. Inspect immediately before acting and use a node ID from the latest frame when possible. The per-kind field requirements are expressed below.

nodeID.description: Stable node ID from the latest live accessibility frame.

point.description: Normalized point in the target's largest accessible window.

text.description: Text to type, match, replace, or paste, capped at 32 KiB of UTF-8. Only setValue accepts an empty string. Action summaries and automation evidence retain only its character count. An explicitly requested subsequent observation reads visible UI state and may naturally contain the resulting field value.

selection.description: selectText only. Prefix and suffix must be immediately adjacent to the phrase and are capped at 4 KiB each. Matching is exact and must identify one occurrence; selection uses UTF-16 ranges. Unsupported, disabled, secure, changed, or unavailable editable targets are rejected without fallback input.

plainText.description: Required only for HTML paste; the plain-text clipboard representation, capped at 16 KiB of UTF-8.

accessibilityAction.description: Action currently exposed by the selected node, such as press or increment.

unlockForegroundActions.description: NOT RECOMMENDED. Allows Pablo to activate the target for pointer, scroll, drag, typing, paste, key, and fallback click input. Agents must leave this false unless the user explicitly accepts the focus change.

LiveActionOutput.description: Successful dispatch with resolved application context. actionID matches any recorded automation evidence. A dispatched event or successful AX call does not verify the application's resulting effect. Supplied text is not echoed; optional observation reads actual visible UI state. An observation failure does not undo dispatch. Paste keeps temporary clipboard representations available for 500 ms after posting the shortcut; consumption by the target remains unverified. Cleanup restores the saved clipboard only if its change count still matches. A newer clipboard writer is preserved, and restoration failure is explicit.

SafariDOMRequest.description: A bounded command for the active Safari tab explicitly unlocked through the extension toolbar button. Actions require documentGeneration from a fresh dump. Opaque nodeID values refer to exact nodes in that document and expire after replacement, navigation, or bounded-history eviction. A dispatched action reports effectStatus unverified. Dumps are bounded to 1 MiB and count every visited node, including text and hidden nodes.

selector.description: CSS selector for an action target. Supply selector or nodeID, not both.

nodeID.description: Opaque node ID returned by a fresh DOM or accessibility dump.

documentGeneration.description: Required for actions; optional freshness condition for dumps.

value.description: Value for setValue. Responses and automation evidence expose only its character count.

tabID.description: An unlocked tab ID returned by safari.tabs. If omitted, Pablo uses Safari's active tab in its current window.
Current unlocked tab ID returned by safari.tabs.

recordingPath.description: Absolute path to a .pablo package whose event source is rrweb.

recordingID.description: Server-generated recording identifier from a manifest.

RRWebStatusOutput.description: Unknown lifecycle acknowledgments preserve the active package and spool. A new start or pause/resume is blocked until status confirms the recorder; stop can retrieve a retained stop acknowledgment to finish recovery.

events.description: Bounded rrweb events, present only when includeEvents is true.

liveObservations.description: Active in-memory native input observations. Stop them through observationStop or the human Stop Live Observation control.

streamIssues.description: Sticky active recording failures; a later successful write does not erase missing evidence.

output.description: Structured inspection, live action, Safari, rrweb, and review results. Live action output separates dispatch from observed application effect.

RecordingCompletion.description: Retained outcome of the latest recording start failure or finalization, including a recoverable package path when available.
